summary: American Healthcare REIT, Inc., a Maryland-based self-managed REIT, owns and operates a diversified portfolio of clinical healthcare real estate across the U.S., U.K., and the Isle of Man. Its focus includes senior housing, skilled nursing facilities (SNFs), outpatient medical (OM) buildings, and other healthcare-related properties. The company utilizes a fully integrated management platform and operates senior housing under the RIDEA structure. thesis: American Healthcare REIT, Inc. memiliki fundamental lemah (skor 46/100) dengan keunggulan utama di pertumbuhan (78) dan kesehatan keuangan (64). Titik lemahnya ada di kualitas bisnis (24). Gabungan model DCF, multiple sektor, dan target analis menghasilkan nilai wajar $46.94 — potensi turun 18.8% dalam ~12 bulan (keyakinan rendah). Kondisi teknikal sangat kuat (84/100). Risiko geopolitik rendah.
